# JalebiMC

> JalebiMC is an Indian Lifesteal SMP Minecraft server with Java and Bedrock cross-play. Winning a PvP fight steals a heart from your opponent; players raid, build team bases and can be revived.

## Connect
- Java Edition: fun.jalebimc.in port 30109 (versions 1.7.2 – 26.x)
- Bedrock Edition: bedrock.jalebimc.in port 30186
- Discord: https://dsc.gg/jalebimc
- Web store: https://store.jalebimc.in

## Pages
- [Home](https://jalebimc.in/): overview and live status
- [How to Join](https://jalebimc.in/how-to-join): Java and Bedrock steps
- [Store](https://jalebimc.in/store): ranks, keys and coin packages, prices in INR
- [Rules](https://jalebimc.in/rules): community rules
- [FAQ](https://jalebimc.in/faq): common questions
- [Punishment Appeal](https://jalebimc.in/appeal): form to appeal a ban or mute
